turn.user_message: Walk me through the daily automation
turn.context: From the landing page, or the door in Solutions so-06. Playbook §4, Automations: the reference's automation, on this hospital's night.

text: Here is one night on one ward, from the evening round to the patient going home.
Eight stations run by themselves. A person steps in at three of them, only to approve.
chat.pointer: Press Play the night, or move the clock. Pick a station to see what it reads and makes.
chat.invite: Pick any station to go deeper. The summary is the best place to start.
chat.note: The machines work all night. People only say yes.

points.label: The summary on the evening round

prompts: How is the summary drafted all through the stay?
What does the doctor have to do?

blocks.title: The night shift that runs by itself
blocks.deck: Eight stations on one line, from the evening round to going home. A hand marks where a person says yes.

stations.title: Summary drafted
stations.does: The doctor says on the round that the patient can likely go. Tojo drafts the summary from notes already in your files.

hand.does: Reads the early summary on the ward phone and signs it

stations.title: Bill brought up to date
stations.does: Every charge of the stay is already on the bill. Tojo adds what the patient will use before leaving.

stations.title: Supply count worked out
stations.does: Tojo works out which unused medicines and supplies can go back to the pharmacy.
stations.makes: The return list for the nurses

stations.title: Early insurance request
stations.does: The expected bill goes to the insurance desk that evening, for first approval.
stations.reads: The expected bill and the summary

stations.title: Family and pharmacy told
stations.does: The family gets a likely time to leave. The pharmacy gets the list of medicines to pack.

stations.title: Morning sign-off
stations.does: The final summary appears on the doctor’s phone on the morning round.

hand.does: Confirms the discharge and signs in one tap

stations.title: Final bill and insurance
stations.does: The signed summary sends the final bill and the reports to the insurance desk by itself.

hand.does: Checks the final bill before it goes out

stations.title: Empty bed alert
stations.does: The moment the patient leaves, housekeeping and the bed desk hear, with the bed number.
stations.reads: The leaving time on the ward

blocks.condition: Every station is designed, not switched on. The times are goals. Not yet measured here.
